inputs.text: [excited] He was 5 meters 50 long — as long as a big SUV! 1 meter 80 tall — [quickly] as tall as Dad standing up! And 1,800 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as a rhino! Scientists think he could run about 16 miles an hour — as fast as a bike going fast.
[confident] Yes, with a beautiful curved horn on his nose, like a crescent moon.
